mostWorthwhile.text: Mineralising the collagen framework was most worthwhile: the planned comparison connects collagen's toughness and mineral's resistance to compression to bone structure.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the joint components was clear but predictable, with each successive fitting largely following its pictured role.

surprise.text: The bone-cell cutaway showed how embedded cells remain connected through tiny channels, and the later vessel cutaway traced nutrients toward them.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, although the shift from developing bone cells to assembling a separate mature-bone framework required following the chapter's stated change of view.

continue.text: I would continue to see how the assembled skeleton connects to movement; the structure-and-function explanations were useful, even if the assembly choices were fairly direct.
